states.description: Person is sitting at the desk, initially looking at phone.

rules.trigger: Person sits at the desk or Person returns to the desk.
rules.action: Pick up the book and place it next to the person.

states.description: Person is reading a book at the desk.

rules.trigger: Person looks at the book or Person leaves the desk.
rules.action: Pick up the mug and place it next to the person.
Pick up the mug and place it in the dishwasher.

rules.trigger: Person closes the book or Person leaves the desk.
rules.action: Pick up the laptop and place it next to the person.

states.description: Person is working on a laptop at the desk.

rules.trigger: Person types on the laptop or Person opens the laptop.
rules.action: Pick up the can and place it next to the person.
Pick up the can and place it in the trash can.

states.description: Person is leaving the desk area to turn off lights.

rules.trigger: Person walks to the light switch or Person reaches for the light switch.

states.description: Person is in bed, looking at phone.

rules.trigger: Person puts the phone on the bed or Person reaches for the bedside lamp.

next.on: Person puts the phone on the bed.

states.description: Person is in bed, lights are off.
